rows.text: Disclosure under Regulation 30(13) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Receipt of Order from the SEBI

the **NCLT Indore dismisses Oswal Woollen Mills' section 9 insolvency application against the company** by order of 3 September, uploaded 8 September — a favourable outcome, not a fresh distress event.
